This '''individual''' was a [[Troxan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served his [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Troxar]], as the [[under-palatine for patriotic liaisons]] and the [[first diplomatic legatee]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that conflict, this Troxan was sent to negotiate with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the second round of such talks in which his species had participated. Although the talks produced no results, the under-palatine was presented with a package by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], which she asked him to deliver to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="YDR 1">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 1.</ref>

The under-palatine for patriotic liaison later joined a delegation from his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to visit [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] at [[Château Malreaux]], on the planet [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. In a bid to win more support for the world's resistance to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the under-palatine and his compatriots tried to convince Dooku that they were planning to surrender to the Republic unless more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] arrived in their [[Troxar system/Legends|system]]. Dooku used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince them to keep fighting, that reinforcements were on their way&mdash;but not to surrender. This was part of a bid by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to make Troxar a resource sink for the Republic.<ref name="YDR 1" />

The under-palatine was a rotund Troxan in his middle years of life. He had a protuberant nose and prominent gills on his neck. He was served by an [[Unidentified Troxan assistant|assistant]].<ref name="YDR 1" />
